method.top10: Top 10 (new today first): the covered news stories (kind news) with a post in the 24 hours ending at the window end (pulse.py NOW, printed in BRT, UTC-3). First the stories first seen in that window (first seen = the earliest post in our sample), by heat; then the rest by heat, up to 10 in all. Ties break by the newest post (later first), then by stable id (ascending). Each row reads "new today" or "first seen <date>" (BRT date); every other story of the day keeps the same evidence record
method.records: evidence record (one per story; state proposed: the pipeline proposes no verdict and writes no label word, the owner confirms by PR): the stable story id, the computed fields it was built from (voices, posts per network, newsletters carrying it, official post, HN points, heat, complaint share, key words, topics), the status of each source, the method version and the config hash (first 16 hex of sha256 over the version, the method text and the sha256 of topics_lexicon.json, newsletters.json and official_feeds.json). A network is fetched when one of its adapters read ok, partial when one read partial, else not fetched. A count reads "not fetched", never 0 or false, when no post of it was seen and its source was not fully fetched; official reads true when a lab or vendor feed posted the story and false only when the official feeds were fully fetched. Substance is the story's own links (its refs: GitHub repositories and arXiv papers its shown posts link to) and its official post; tracker samples of its topics read "related in topic" and never count as substance
method.gauges: gauges (at most four; each reads "preview, not yet reproducible" until 14 ledger days, a green recompute verifier and the owner's confirm; no trend line or arrow before 14 ledger days; no combined score). "Releases / research output by area" = papers published and repos created on the 7 UTC dates ending with the window end's, per tracker area, among the papers and repos in data.json (output volume, not capability); null when the tracker was not read in this run or its data is older than the window. "Hype vs substance" = for each Top 10 story its spread (voices, posts per network, newsletters, HN points) beside its substance (official post, own repo and paper links), components only, no ratio; null with no Top 10 story. "Daily movers" = the five topics whose rising ratio (conversation posts in the last day / daily average over 7 days; it needs 4+ conversation posts in 7 days and 2+ in the last day) is highest above 1 (up) and the five lowest below 1 (down), with all-network posts in 1 and 7 days for context; null when no topic has a reading or no conversation network was fetched. Below its floor a gauge is null with the reason; no value carries over from an earlier run. Coverage is the status of the sources a gauge reads. Risk (a dated, sourced event log, no dial) and Jobs read "no qualified source" until a qualified source exists
